row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: No SCIM appears on the Canvas tier page or in the Canvas REST API reference; Microsoft's Entra tutorial says "In the case of Canvas, user provisioning is a manual task," and Okta's OIN app is SAML only.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to unknown. The June 'gated / All institutional plans' row had no first-party SCIM source and was dropped. Every reachable source points to no SCIM: the tier page (Core/Plus/Next, quote only) and the Canvas REST API reference and developer-docs index never mention SCIM, the Entra gallery app is SSO-only with manual provisioning, and the OIN app lists SAML only. The Instructure Community help centre (Canvas guides) returned 403 to every fetch, so absence could not be confirmed there and the row stays unknown. Provisioning is done with SIS imports (CSV/API), the Users/Logins REST API, or JIT on SAML/OIDC/LDAP/CAS authentication providers.
